Subject: New: Trailwool Socks — Three Pairs, One Pack, Merino All Day
Preview: Built for the long haul. Meet the Northbay Trailwool Sock.
Body: You already know what a bad sock day feels like — the bunching, the hot spots, the distraction when you should be watching the trail.

The Northbay Trailwool Sock (NB-SOK-11) is built from a merino wool blend, which regulates temperature, wicks moisture, and reduces friction against your foot. It comes three pairs to a pack, so you're covered across a multi-day trip without doing laundry math.

Merino is well-suited to high-output days in variable conditions. These aren't a pool sock or a casual sneaker liner — they're made for people putting in real miles.

No discount, no gimmick. Just a sock that earns its place in your kit.
